Subject: [opensuse] System Lockups Anyone?

Looks like maybe the newest kernel(s) are a problem. I just had hard system
lockups twice today with 2.6.22.17-0.1-default on VIA VP3 K6/2. I'm running
the original 2.6.22.5-31-default now to see if any better. I also have 10.2
with its latest kernel on the same system and haven't had any lockups with it.

Also, I haven't figured out which combination of noapic, acpi=off and/or
irqpoll are actually required on this FIC-503+ motherboard with recent
kernels. Has anyone already gotten this figured out?
